reproduction_boundary: Read-only diagnostic commands are in this conversation. This is a recorded inspection, not a packaged or preregistered population estimator. Arithmetic expressions were interpreted through an AST numeric whitelist and independently recomputed in PowerShell; source programs, imports and model training were not executed.

limits: Presence is not runtime reachability, peak demand, adaptive training, or production frequency.
Clock calls may only log elapsed time. CPU-count calls may be capped and insensitive to the tested allocation.
Five mem_get_info programs belong to three tasks; related parent/child code is not independent replication.

closed_16370_backlog_identifiability.conclusion: The controller admits only two search workers per wave and waits for both before the next wave. Each already holds a task GPU before generation. The trace therefore does not identify the benefit of admitting an additional ready candidate after releasing a generation-phase lease.
limits: Result-file counts are not successful or valid-evaluation counts.
No GPU utilization or execution-ready queue series was measured here.
Generation calls record duration but not a dedicated start/end event; file mtime is not promoted to an execution timestamp.
Changed admission changes future generator arrivals and durations; shifting old durations is not a causal throughput result.
The prior 22.72496% whole-pool reservation window remains descriptive, not attainable saving.

prospective_workload_readiness.new_gpu_budget_request: 6 legal development programs, at least 2 tasks including real GPU computation; serial versus at most two concurrent programs, 3 identical restarts; 36 executions; 1 RTX3090, at most 90 minutes including qualification and failure overhead, at most 1.5 GPU hours

no_external_weight_syntax_filter.four_initial_hits: Two tabular-playground-series-dec-2021 and two stanford-covid-vaccine programs import torch for CUDA detection and train XGBoost, not an identified neural network. Missing neural imports are not evidence of CPU-only execution.
no_external_weight_syntax_filter.dec2021_followup: The frozen sample also has two CatBoost programs. XGBoost paths request device=cuda when available; CatBoost paths choose task_type=GPU when a device exists. Actual GPU computation and completion were not tested.
no_external_weight_syntax_filter.data_boundary: Only existing prepared/public file names and sizes were checked; no input rows or private evaluation files were read. These full task inputs have not been admitted as a new development split.

prospective_workload_readiness.additional_baseline_requirement: For later live experiments, both A0 and A1 need the same rolling replacement rule. Old wave-barrier behavior is a historical diagnostic, not the only strong baseline.
prospective_workload_readiness.launch_gate: No launch before explicit batch approval, a fixed qualified workload, dependencies and same-device/private-workspace isolation. Never silently substitute CPU or a shorter training configuration.

six_hour_follow_up.old_preflight_package_versions: no corresponding top-level version field; no package compatibility claim
six_hour_follow_up.inspection_limit: Attribute/name syntax only, no alias or runtime signature resolution. The fit early_stopping_rounds occurrence flags a compatibility check; absence does not certify compatibility. No candidate run, model import, package change, data-row read or quality-score read.

direction_decision: Keep R14. Treat resource-dependent program choices as an equivalence check in the throughput comparison, not a new main method or proof of quality harm. Do not start a semantic scheduler or change candidate code on this evidence alone.
